hm.titel: Secure a majority for the budget
hm.keineGarantie: 301 votes meet the threshold. A buffer of eight votes reduces voting risk but does not guarantee passage.
hm.einfachRisiko: Cheaper, but with no reserve: a few dissenters can defeat the budget.
hm.pufferRisiko: Target: 309 expected yes votes. Later political changes can still consume this buffer.
hm.abspracheFolge: Applies only to this budget bill. The price is charged immediately; no new policy pledge is created. Under the existing rules, budget vote agreements require no additional attention.
hm.pufferSteht: The current forecast already includes at least eight reserve votes. You can still seek broader support.
hm.auswahl: Available agreements, ranked by remaining vote gap and then cost. The overview shows one route per party; more variants can be expanded.
hm.keinAbkommen: No immediately available agreement adds support by the vote. In Parliament you can review willingness, demands and conversation cooldowns. An existing support agreement can only be renewed after it expires.
hm.bruch: {name} ({partei}) has {loyal} loyalty. The monthly review on {datum}, before or on the vote, puts {sitze} government seats at risk. The forecast assumes the party remains in the coalition; stabilise the partner in time.
hm.kapital: The required capital exceeds even the available overdraft.
hm.veraltet: Conditions have changed. Review the updated offer; nothing was charged.
hm.beendet: The term has ended; no new budget action is available.
hm.anzahl: Agree on a valid number between 1 and 600 votes.
hm.einbringenWarum: At the vote on {datum}, {ja} yes votes are expected; {noetig} are required. Known support deadlines are included. Vote deals or party agreements can strengthen the majority. If the bill fails, the previous budget continues and the government loses legitimacy. Later events and voting variation remain possible.
